biotools.summary: AgingResearch.News is a web application for finding and following research on aging and age-related disease. It connects biomedical papers with evidence summaries, clinical trials, research grants and related topics. Readers can search the public site, use topic RSS feeds, or connect an AI assistant through its MCP API. Paper summaries are generated and checked by AI, with links to the underlying research and its limitations. Public reading is free; personalized features and higher API allowances require an account or paid plan.

function.note: Search new aging research papers, their evidence, clinical trials, grants and drug programs; on the site, through the data API or the MCP server.
